name: Bloodplague Lockdown
detailed_description:
In this third person action adventure inspired by classic survival horror games, you will play the role of an FBI agent and travel to a secret research base that has been sealed off for many years to investigate the source of the virus. Abandoned corridors, dilapidated laboratories, residual surveillance footage, and scattered bloodstains pieced together a tragedy deliberately covered up. As exploration deepens, you will discover that this place has never truly been 'abandoned'.

The thrilling survival battle: With limited ammunition and resources, every shot must be carefully considered before taking action.

Immersive horror atmosphere: Realistic art style and sound design make people step by step shocked.

In depth exploration of the plot story: Fragmented information waiting for you to piece together the truth with your own hands.

Puzzles and Mechanism Systems: Not only do we need physical force, but we also need to use our brains to solve puzzles in order to continue delving into the core area.

Are you ready to face the secrets deep within the base?

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580

content_descriptors.notes: ﻿There are combat scenes in the game, including special effects such as explosions, strikes, and blood sprays, and some enemies may be accompanied by dismemberment effects when they die. The content is fictional and does not involve sexual assault/non consensual behavior, drug and alcohol abuse, or self harm.
